+
+* **Single product backlog and Product Owner.**  All teams within a Nexus share one Product Backlog managed by a single Product Owner【996175366309251†L201-L211】.  This arrangement ensures a consistent set of priorities and removes ambiguity around work sequencing.
+
+* **Nexus Integration Team (NIT).**  The Nexus adds a new role called the **Nexus Integration Team**. It provides transparent accountability for integration across the Scrum teams.  The NIT comprises the Product Owner, a Scrum Master and representatives from the teams【594437942851†L523-L530】.

+
